current-bfd470c.error: Windows file-lock interrupted run persistence; server ended this same session with timeout. No replacement session.

limitation: Includes two previously completed reference sessions and two new sessions. Different versions ran at different times; two repeats cannot establish generalization or isolate LLM causality. Multiple controller changes are bundled. No extra Practice attempts. D02 repetition 2 then suffered a Windows file-lock crash and server timeout: its actual zero score is included, not discarded. It does not measure LLM-only variation. The subsequent storage and delivery-probe fixes were locally tested only. One D02 start was rejected with HTTP 429 before creating a session and was retried when capacity became available; that rejection is recorded separately.
